reviews.t: High Sulfur works great
reviews.x: This soap is the highest sulfur content, but it dissolves fast. If you don’t take special care to keep it away from running water it will dissolve before your eyes. Know that, if you soap up whatever you’re working on and keep it away from running water you can 10 or so uses out of it and it’s gone; that is plenty of time for it to do its job. Make sure not to get this in your eyes or on silver jewelry, it burns and turns silver black.

reviews.t: I Had Dark Spots And It Works For Me!
reviews.x: I Absolutely love this product. To start off I've had TV for +9 years and specifically for me I had hyper-pigmentation (dark spots) and there was no part of my body where you couldn't see it. After only one use of this product I noticed a big difference! Instead of the usual rough scaly skin, my skin was a lot smoother and it didn't look nearly as dry. I have nothing but love for this product and will continue to order this in the future.

reviews.t: No real change with Tinea…
reviews.x: Been using this soap now for a few weeks. Gone through about 1 bar and a half. Haven't really noticed a change in the spots on my arms. They aren't getting worse, but certainly not better. I've used the soap in the shower, once a day. It recommends 2-4 times a day. Will continue using it and update if it just takes a long time to notice a change.

reviews.x: This works! Takes a good week or 2 but it works! Like so many others who purchased this, I get this rash on my back seasonally and I don’t like taking an RX or using RX creams. This Is very gentle, does not dry me out, and the lavender scent is actually soothing. I saw results after a week and my rash is almost completely faded after

reviews.t: Bought with hope it works as a preventative for future outbreaks
reviews.x: Used a different product to clear most recent outbreak of tinea versicolor. Bought this soap to use as a preventative to hopefully prevent another outbreak. Tough to evaluate if its really working for that purpose as there has never been a good rhyme or reason why or when outbreaks occur. So evaluating on smell as much as anything. Not my favorite smelling soap. A bit more perfumey and lavenderish than I would prefer, but not a terrible smell like I feared.

reviews.t: Decent product, but no effect on tinea versicolor
reviews.x: Product was shipped in a timely matter, but sadly it had no effect on my versicolor. Not everyone's tinea versicolor will be treated the same so that's why I left a few stars. The soap itself has one side smooth and one side rough and gritty. After a couple uses though the rough side turns smooth and feels like it isn't really having as much of an impact as before. They need to make the rough side a bit deeper to last through many uses.

reviews.t: Five stars for a product that works!
reviews.x: Had this issue for years, and finally decided to do something about it. Applied the product as a few on here have recommended- creating a thin film, and spreading it over the affected areas. I’ve been using the soap for four days, and my skin is almost entirely clear.   And it smells nice- someone on here claimed it smells like “eggs?” Really not my experience.  Definitely recommend.

reviews.t: Slighly smelly (duh) but great for Tinea Versicolor.
reviews.x: I've been using this every time I shower along with Lamisil spray and my Tinea Versicolor is pretty much gone. I am so thankful and relieved, since I thought it was something I had to accept for the rest of of my life, as nothing helped previously. I feel more confident and beautiful! The smell is expected and it washes away with the soap. Yay!

claims.text: Many reviewers report their tinea versicolor cleared up or greatly improved after using the soap, often after years of failed treatments.
Some reviewers say the soap did not help their tinea versicolor or was slow to work.
The sulfur smell is noted as strong or unusual, though some find it acceptable.
The bar dissolves quickly and lasts only about a week of use.
The soap did not cause irritation or burning, unlike other treatments reviewers had tried.
